title: Continuation and missing work
summary: The principal blocker to true end-to-end large-object streaming is the HTTPS host boundary, not WebDAV's Storage-side contract.
invariants: Do not invent an HTTPS streaming API from the existing v0.4.4 body-object interface.
Next HTTPS work needs bounded request-body source/callback, disconnect notification, response writer backpressure, abort/finalize hooks and body-free retained transport evidence.
Once HTTPS exposes that seam, bind PUT directly to WebDavStreamingUploadSession and full GET to StorageByteSource.
Further WebDAV work includes full multi-resource tagged If semantics for COPY/MOVE, optional RFC 6578 selection details, live OS/client interoperability and live Queue Fabric broker qualification.

provenance.claim: F13 identifies WebDAV streaming/media fidelity as the open transport seam.
